```{r libraries, results='hide', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE, echo = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(lubridate)
library(patchwork)
library(kableExtra)
library(viridis)
library(scico)

library(scoringutils)
library(hubUtils)
library(hubEnsembles)
```

# Data
```{r}
state_coverage <- read.csv("../Data/state-scoring/state_coverage.csv")
state_wis <- read.csv("../Data/state-scoring/state_wis.csv")

standard_coverage <- read.csv("../Data/standard-scoring/standard_coverage.csv")
standard_wis <- read.csv("../Data/standard-scoring/standard_wis.csv")
```

```{r}
standard_wis$reference_date = as.Date(standard_wis$reference_date)

standard_coverage$reference_date = as.Date(standard_coverage$reference_date)
state_coverage$reference_date = as.Date(state_coverage$reference_date)
```

```{r}
state_wis <- state_wis |> mutate(reference_date = as.Date(target_end_date) - (horizon - 1) * 7)
```

```{r}
dates_to_remove <- as.Date(c("2025-11-22", "2025-11-29", "2025-12-06", "2025-12-13"))

standard_wis = standard_wis |> filter(!reference_date %in% dates_to_remove)
state_wis = state_wis |> filter(!reference_date %in% dates_to_remove)

standard_coverage = standard_coverage |> filter(!reference_date %in% dates_to_remove)
state_coverage = state_coverage |> filter(!reference_date %in% dates_to_remove)
```

# Subfigures
```{r}
model_ids <- c("NAU-Copycat", "NAU-INFLAenza", "UMass-SAR", "UMass-alloy", "UT-GBQR", "VTSanghani-PRIME", "epiENGAGE-baseline", "epiENGAGE-ensemble_mean", "epiENGAGE-lop_norm", "epiforecasts-dyngam")
```

## Figure 1a
```{r}
standard_wis_1a = standard_wis |> filter(location != 'nyc')
state_wis_1a = state_wis |> filter(location != 'nyc')

temp1a_state = state_wis_1a |> group_by(model_id, target) |>  summarise(mean_wis = mean(wis), count = n(), .groups = 'drop')
temp1a_state$type = "state-scoring"

temp1a_standard = standard_wis_1a |> group_by(model_id, target) |>  summarise(mean_wis = mean(wis), count = n(), .groups = 'drop')
temp1a_standard$type = "standard-scoring"

temp1a = rbind(temp1a_standard, temp1a_state)
temp1a = temp1a |> 
  filter(target == "Flu ED visits pct",
         !model_id %in% c("epiENGAGE-GBQR", "ACCIDDA-InfluPaint", "MOBS-EpyStrain_Flu"),
         model_id != "FluSight-ensemble")

temp1a$model_id <- factor(temp1a$model_id,
  levels = model_ids)
```

```{r}
figure1a = ggplot(temp1a, aes(x = model_id, y = mean_wis, fill = type)) + 
  geom_col(position = "dodge", color = "black") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("standard-scoring" = "firebrick", "state-scoring" = "royalblue")) +
  scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0, add = 0.03)) +
  labs(x = "Model", y = "Mean WIS", fill = "Scoring Method") + 
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text            = element_text(size = 27),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 24, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 27),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 24),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 25.5),
    strip.text      = element_text(size = 25.5)
  ) +
  theme(legend.position = "top") + scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) gsub("-", "-\n", x))

figure1a
```

### Location version 
```{r}
temp1a_state = state_wis |> filter(target == "Flu ED visits pct") |> filter(model_id != "epiENGAGE-GBQR") |> filter(model_id != "FluSight-ensemble") |> group_by(location, target) |>  summarise(mean_wis = mean(wis), count = n(), .groups = 'drop')
temp1a_state$type = "state-scoring"

temp1a_standard = standard_wis |> filter(target == "Flu ED visits pct") |> filter(model_id != "epiENGAGE-GBQR") |> filter(model_id != "FluSight-ensemble") |> group_by(location, target) |>  summarise(mean_wis = mean(wis), count = n(), .groups = 'drop')
temp1a_standard$type = "standard-scoring"

temp1a = rbind(temp1a_standard, temp1a_state)
```

## Figure 5
```{r}
state_wis_5 = state_wis |> rename(state_wis = wis)

complete_wis <- state_wis_5 %>%
  left_join(standard_wis, by = intersect(colnames(state_wis_5), colnames(standard_wis)))

# complete_wis$relative_wis <- complete_wis$wis / complete_wis$state_wis
complete_wis = complete_wis |> select("location", "target_end_date", "horizon", "reference_date",  "model_id", "target", "wis",  "state_wis") |> filter(         !model_id %in% c("epiENGAGE-GBQR", "ACCIDDA-InfluPaint", "MOBS-EpyStrain_Flu"),
         model_id != "FluSight-ensemble")

# complete_wis <- complete_wis %>%
#   filter(wis > 0)
```

```{r}
sum(is.na(complete_wis)) 
# complete_wis = na.omit(complete_wis)
```

```{r}
complete_wis_long <- complete_wis %>%
  pivot_longer(
    cols = c("wis", "state_wis"),
    names_to = "method",
    values_to = "wis_score"
  ) %>%
  mutate(method = case_when(
    method == "wis" ~ "standard",
    method == "state_wis" ~ "state"
  ))

complete_wis_long <- complete_wis_long %>% rename(wis = wis_score)

class(complete_wis_long) <- c("scores", "data.table", class(complete_wis_long))
attr(complete_wis_long, "metrics") <- "wis"

head(complete_wis_long)
```
### Version 1
```{r}
temp1b <- suppressWarnings(
  complete_wis_long %>%
    filter(target == "Flu ED visits pct") %>%
    get_pairwise_comparisons(
      compare = "method",
      by = c("model_id", "location"),
      baseline = "state"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      method == "standard",
      compare_against == "state",
      !model_id %in% c("epiENGAGE-GBQR", "ACCIDDA-InfluPaint", "MOBS-EpyStrain_Flu"),
      model_id != "FluSight-ensemble"
    ) %>%
    mutate(model_id = factor(model_id, levels = model_ids))
)
```

```{r}
#knitr::kable(temp1b)
```

```{r, fig.height = 10, fig.width = 10}
figure1b_loc <- ggplot(temp1b, aes(x = model_id, y = location, fill = log(wis_scaled_relative_skill))) + 
  scale_fill_gradient2(
  low = "#2166ac", 
  mid = "grey90", 
  high = "#d73027", 
  midpoint = 0
) + 
  geom_tile(col = "black") + 
  labs(x = "Model", y = "Location", fill = "Log Scaled Relative Skill Score (WIS)") + 
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    text            = element_text(size = 27),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 24, angle = 60, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 27),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 24),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 25.5),
    strip.text      = element_text(size = 25.5),
    legend.key.width  = unit(3, "cm"),
    legend.key.height = unit(0.6, "cm")
  ) +
  guides(fill = guide_colorbar(
    title.position = "top",
    title.hjust = 0.5,
    barwidth = unit(6, "cm"),
    barheight = unit(0.6, "cm")
  )) + scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) gsub("-", "-\n", x))

figure1b_loc
```

### Date line
```{r}
temp1b_date_line <- suppressWarnings(
  complete_wis_long %>%
    filter(target == "Flu ED visits pct") %>%
    get_pairwise_comparisons(
      compare = "method",
      by = c("model_id", "target_end_date", "horizon"),
      baseline = "state"
    ) %>%
    filter(
      method == "standard",
      compare_against == "state",
      !model_id %in% c("epiENGAGE-GBQR", "ACCIDDA-InfluPaint", "MOBS-EpyStrain_Flu"),
      model_id != "FluSight-ensemble"
    ) %>%
    mutate(model_id = factor(model_id, levels = model_ids))
)
```

```{r}
horizon_labels <- c(
  "1" = "Horizon 1",
  "2" = "Horizon 2",
  "3" = "Horizon 3",
  "4" = "Horizon 4"
)
```

```{r}
figure1b_date_line <- ggplot(temp1b_date_line, aes(x = as.Date(target_end_date), y = wis_scaled_relative_skill, color = model_id)) + 
  geom_line() +
  geom_point() +
  geom_hline(yintercept = 1,linetype = "dashed", color = "black") +
  scale_y_log10() +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = c(setNames(scales::hue_pal()(length(unique(temp1b_date_line$model_id)) - 1),
                         setdiff(unique(temp1b_date_line$model_id), "epiENGAGE-ensemble_mean")),
                "epiENGAGE-ensemble_mean" = "black")
  ) +
  labs(x = "Date", y = "Scaled Relative Skill Score (WIS)") + 
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(
    legend.position = "top",
    text            = element_text(size = 27),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 27),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 24),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 25.5),
    strip.text      = element_text(size = 25.5),
    legend.key.size = unit(1, "cm")  
    ) +
    guides(color = guide_legend(override.aes = list(linewidth = 2)))+ 
    scale_x_date(date_breaks = "1 month",
    date_labels = "%b '%y") + facet_wrap(~horizon, ncol = 2, labeller = as_labeller(horizon_labels))
figure1b_date_line
```

```{r}
comparisons_by_location <- get_pairwise_comparisons(
  scores = standard_wis_10,
  compare = "model_id",
  by = "location",
  baseline = "epiENGAGE-baseline"
)

head(comparisons_by_location)

temp10_loc <- comparisons_by_location %>%
  filter(compare_against == "epiENGAGE-baseline") |> filter(model_id != 'epiENGAGE-baseline')

temp10_loc
```

```{r}
temp10_loc_avg <- temp10_loc %>%
  group_by(location) %>%
  summarize(
    wis_scaled_relative_skill = exp(mean(log(wis_scaled_relative_skill))),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) 

lookup = read.csv("../Data/lookup.csv")
temp10_loc_avg = temp10_loc_avg |> left_join(lookup, by = "location") 
temp10_loc_avg$state_classification = ifelse(temp10_loc_avg$state == 'state', 'state', 'not-state')
temp10_loc_avg = temp10_loc_avg |> mutate(state = ifelse(state == 'state', location, state))
temp10_loc_avg = temp10_loc_avg |> arrange(desc(state == 'state'), desc(state), wis_scaled_relative_skill) |>
  mutate(location = factor(location, levels = location))


state_boundaries = which(diff(as.numeric(factor(temp10_loc_avg$state, 
                                                 levels = unique(temp10_loc_avg$state)))) != 0) + 0.5

(temp10_loc_avg)
```

```{r, fig.height=6, fig.width=14}
figure10_loc = ggplot(temp10_loc_avg, aes(x = location, y = wis_scaled_relative_skill, fill = state)) + 
  geom_col(aes(alpha = state_classification), width = 0.7, color = "black") +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c("state" = 1.2, "not-state" = 0.2)) +
  labs(x = "Location", y = "Relative skill score (WIS)") + 
  theme_bw() +
  theme(
    text            = element_text(size = 27),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 24, angle = 90, hjust = 1, vjust = 0.5),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 27),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 16),      # smaller so it fits
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 18),
    strip.text      = element_text(size = 25.5),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.key.size = unit(0.5, "cm"),
    legend.spacing.x = unit(0.2, "cm"),
    plot.margin     = margin(t = 5, r = 15, b = 5, l = 5)
  ) +
  guides(
    fill  = guide_legend(nrow = 3, byrow = TRUE),   # wrap into 3 rows
    alpha = guide_legend(nrow = 1)
  ) +
  scale_y_log10() + 
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = 1), col = "black", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1.2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = state_boundaries, color = "black", linewidth = 1.0)

figure10_loc
```


## Figure 1d
```{r}
state_coverage = state_coverage |> filter(location != 'nyc')
standard_coverage = standard_coverage |> filter(location != 'nyc')

temp1d_state = state_coverage |> group_by(model_id, target) |>  
  summarise(mean_coverage = mean(coverage_95), count = n(), .groups = 'drop')
temp1d_state$type = "state-scoring"

temp1d_standard = standard_coverage |> group_by(model_id, target) |> 
  summarise(mean_coverage = mean(coverage_95), count = n(), .groups = 'drop')
temp1d_standard$type = "standard-scoring"

temp1d = rbind(temp1d_standard, temp1d_state)
temp1d = temp1d |> filter(target == "Flu ED visits pct",
         !model_id %in% c("epiENGAGE-GBQR", "ACCIDDA-InfluPaint", "MOBS-EpyStrain_Flu"),
         model_id != "FluSight-ensemble")

temp1d$model_id <- factor(temp1d$model_id,
  levels = model_ids)
```

```{r}
knitr::kable(temp1d)
```

```{r}
figure1d = ggplot(temp1d, aes(x = model_id, y = mean_coverage, fill = type)) + 
  geom_col(col = "black", position = "dodge") + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("standard-scoring" = "firebrick", "state-scoring" = "royalblue")) +
  labs(x = "Model", y = "Mean Coverage (95%)", fill = "Scoring Method") + 
  theme_bw() + 
  theme(legend.position = "top") + 
  theme(
    text            = element_text(size = 27),
    axis.text.x     = element_text(size = 24, angle = 45, hjust = 1, vjust = 1),
    axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 24),
    axis.title      = element_text(size = 27),
    legend.text     = element_text(size = 24),
    legend.title    = element_text(size = 25.5),
    strip.text      = element_text(size = 25.5)
  ) + scale_y_continuous(expand = expansion(mult = 0, add = 0.03)) + scale_x_discrete(labels = function(x) gsub("-", "-\n", x)) + geom_hline(yintercept = 0.95, linetype = "dashed",linewidth = 1)

figure1d
```
